purpose: Verify exact HKD cost arithmetic and original correction shares, authorization, idempotency and atomic rollback. Preserve legacy Fulfillment and AR fixtures before cost activation and bind the real schema migration as an input.
data: New costed Purchase and Return cases use synthetic small batches with up to two detail legs and a single SKU in the existing local fixture. Existing case sizes and the P1 browser setup are unchanged. Arithmetic and context tests use in-memory fixtures.
concurrency: Existing finite two-caller SQL lock tests remain at two. No new runner or increased parallel work.
repetitions: Once at each applicable existing functional run. Development checks run once per selected time zone.
thresholds: Keep existing cases, assertions, caps, deadlines and coverage. Verify exact monetary totals, once-only entries, stable replay and no partial changes on authority or persistence failure.
trigger: Retain existing functional CI discovery and P1 browser config. Purchase and Return native files still use the existing local INVENTORY_PURCHASE_TESTS opt-in; this receipt does not turn it on in CI. No workflow changes.
cost: In-memory and existing functional workloads only, no performance or capacity run and no CI job added. Hosted incremental runtime is unmeasured.
